title: Your Ego vs Everest, the Himalayas, Earth, ISS & the Sun: Real-Time Zoom Out #Shorts
description:
Assume this is you, and this glow is your ego. Now zoom out: Mount Everest is 8.8 km tall, the Himalayas stretch over 2,000 km, Earth is 12,742 km wide, the ISS orbits just 400 km up, and 109 Earths fit across the Sun. Feel the scale.
